question: Can a learned, noise-exposed existence representation preserve writable absence without weakening the frozen content map?
same_information: four supplied addresses, eight frozen codes, exact qualification and complete write encoding; no online oracle or protected field in neural arms
write: score >= 0.5 and matching scope; code is inserted in full, presence coordinates set +1; clear sets content 0 and presence -1
read: mean(p)>0 means present for neural existence arms; otherwise UNKNOWN. This is a declared code interface, not learned qualification. A zero-valued SYMBOL is not empty.
training_match: paired input data/labels/steps/optimizer settings, NOT equal trainable weights/objective/compute; four-coordinate existence buys redundancy with extra state

lifecycle.noise: independent noise on ALL neural coordinates including existence; protected boolean excluded

challenge_tests: one presence-coordinate sign inversion versus all-coordinate inversion
write-delivery attenuation of both content and existence versus content only
frozen weight checks and scoped restore
comparison_limits: synthetic finite-code maintenance, not biological simulation, binding, real language, delayed-credit learning, low-bit state, integration or production qualification
decision_rule: retain only joint lifecycle improvements; no reject-all or permanent-empty solution; keep negative seeds and exact controls; joint every-read success includes correct existence status, so present-but-unreadable cannot masquerade as an empty record
existence_status: A separate recorded presence estimate and readable/unreadable status accompany the legacy 9-class answer. All-read gate requires both answer and status.
